tools.description:
Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace, with numbered lines.
Use `offset` and `limit` to page through a long file; the last line gives the next offset.
Read a file before you edit or overwrite it: a mutation is refused until you have seen its current contents.
`skim` hides comments, docstrings, and blank lines for exploration but never satisfies the full-read prerequisite for mutation.
To read several files, or several ranges of one file, put them into one call with `files` (up to 10 entries, each with `file_path` and its own `offset`, `limit` and `skim`) rather than one call each.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the workspace root or absolute inside it.

files.description: Several files or ranges in one call, instead of `file_path`; each entry takes the same fields as a single read.

file_path.description: File path, relative to the workspace root or absolute inside it.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

skim.description: Hide comments, docstrings, and blank lines while preserving original line numbers.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

skim.description: Hide comments, docstrings, and blank lines while preserving original line numbers.

tools.name: read

tools.description:
Start a worker agent on an environment with a self-contained task.
The worker gets ONLY the task text — no conversation history — so the task must contain everything it needs.
Workers share this workspace: do not give two workers overlapping files.
You will be notified when it finishes; do not poll for it.
The worker has ONLY the tools you list in `tools` (plus finish); tools you do not list do not exist for it. List every tool the task needs; if you are unsure whether it needs one, include it.

environment.description: Environment (prompt, model and tools) the worker runs on.

task.description: The complete, self-contained task for the worker.

tools.description: Every tool module the worker needs. The worker gets ONLY these, plus finish.

tools.name: worker_start

tools.description:
Read a worker's status and its final text.
Set wait to true to block until the worker is no longer running (you can be cancelled while waiting).
Verify the worker's result before relying on it.

wait.description: Block until the worker is no longer running.

tools.name: worker_result

tools.description:
Send another message into a worker's session to repair or extend its work.
Fails while the worker is still running a turn.
Use add_tools to give the worker tools it lacks (e.g. after it finished blocked naming a missing tool); it keeps its context.

add_tools.description: Tool modules to ADD to the worker's grant for this and every later turn. The worker keeps its context.

message.description: The message to send into the worker's session.

tools.name: worker_continue

tools.description: Cancel a running worker's current turn. The worker's session is kept.
tools.name: worker_cancel

tools.description: Start a workflow ONLY when the user asks for a workflow. Write a rhai (JavaScript-like) script that starts workers by ROLE (configured: worker, reviewer, verifier, judge); never name a model in the script. agent(prompt, opts) returns an envelope, not a value: check its status. The run happens in the background and ONE notification arrives at the end; do not poll. Caps are enforced per model: a capped step is failed with quota_exceeded. Never split a workflow into several to get around a cap. resume_from replays the unchanged prefix of an earlier run.

resume_from.description: Earlier run id whose unchanged prefix is replayed.

script.description: Rhai script using roles, not models.

tools.name: workflow_start

tools.description: Read a workflow's compact progress or ended summary. Do not poll: one notification arrives when it ends.
tools.name: workflow_status

tools.description: Read a workflow's result; set wait to true to await its end (the wait can be cancelled). Verify the result before relying on it.

wait.description: Wait for the run to end.

tools.name: workflow_result

tools.description: Cancel a workflow run and its in-flight steps.
tools.name: workflow_cancel
